title: Wanderlust
meta_description: New luxury home one block from the beach with private heated pool, sleeps 12, pet-friendly, modern design, spacious layout, bikes \& outdoor living.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to Wanderlust. A newly constructed home that has a private backyard pool and just a block from the sea. What more could you ask for? How about a lovely, contemporary home designed for multi-generational families and multiple families with enough space to comfortably sleep 12, including a king bedroom on the first floor. The open concept design, with a large kitchen island and dining table for eight, allows everyone to eat, relax and enjoy their time together. And for those who have to work while you're here, there's a dedicated workspace for those times. Let your heart wander to the sea and Wanderlust will do the rest.

\*\*\* Newly Built
\*\*\*Pet Friendly (Pet fee required)
\*\*\* Private Pool- Heated March-May/September-October (Pool will only warm 10 degrees warmer than outside temperature)

ABOUT THE AREA: Panama City Beach is a great location if you want options during your vacation by the sea. Perfectly situated between Inlet Beach and all the shops, restaurants, and activities of Pier Park, you'll run out of time before you run out of options.

BEACH ACCESS: The closest public beach access is south on Kelly Street then left to Bay County Public Beach Access 87 or right to Access 88 and 89.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Bedroom 1 King Bed with Ensuite Bath (1st Floor)
- Bedroom 2 King Bed with Ensuite Bath (2nd Floor)
- Bedroom 3 Bunk Room, (1) Twin/Twin (1) Twin/Full (2nd Floor)
- Bedroom 4 King Bed w/ XL Twin over (2nd Floor)
- Sleeper sofa 2nd floor entertainment space

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
- Private Pool (heated upon request)
- Private backyard
- Outdoor Grill and dining
- 2 Adult Bikes
- Outdoor shower
- King Bedroom on the first floor
- 2nd Floor Entertainment space with Shuffleboard and Sleeper Sofa
- Smart TV s throughout the home
- Full Size Washer and Dryer
- Self-Check-In
- Full linen package: bedding bath towels, wash clothes, etc.
- Fully stocked kitchen

Enjoy an exclusive invitation with your booking to seasonal bonfires on the beach! Book your stay today!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- Guests must be 25 years or older to book this home.

Parking Details:
- This home has 3 parking spaces.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
